ex.s: I never thought I could be a writer.
ex.t: 我从没想过自己能成为一名作家。

ex.s: I would never do that.

ex.s: The 21st century has created a whole range of new types of professionals that we have never had before — or if not quite new, at least newly repackaged.
ex.t: 21世纪创造了一系列我们以前从未有过的新类型专业人士——或者即使不算全新，至少也是被重新包装过的。

ex.s: If you think you can do without the fence because you’ve never seen a fox, consider if the existence of the fence is precisely why you’ve never seen one.
ex.t: 如果你认为自己不需要围栏，因为你从没见过狐狸，那不妨想想：也许正是因为有了围栏，你才从没见过狐狸。

ex.s: Importantly, Chesterton is not saying that things can never be reformed.

ex.s: He never got into trouble, though sometimes he wanted to do risky things.

ex.s: It was a rush I had never experienced before.

ex.s: This unbeatable price-point encouraged me to experiment with dozens of titles that I would never normally consider buying.

ex.s: Other scientists may say scientific findings are true because they use “the scientific method.” But we can never actually agree on what that method is.
ex.t: 其他科学家可能说科学发现是真的，因为他们用了“科学方法”。但我们永远无法真正就那方法是什么达成一致。

ex.s: They never look lazy or untidy.

ex.s: As someone noted in this paper a couple of weeks ago, they eat great food and never gain weight.

ex.s: He never stopped working, never retired.

ex.s: He showed us that even a single desire, never given up on, can make for a remarkable life.
ex.t: 他向我们展示，哪怕只是一个永不放弃的愿望，也能成就非凡的人生。

ex.s: It’s never too late to learn.

ex.s: "I often send postcards to family and friends." he says to China Daily, "but you can imagine that after a while, you never receive as many as you send, and you realize that not everyone is into it   32   ” Seeking other like-minded souls, however, Paulo started looking in a somewhat unlikely place: online.

ex.t: 我母亲一向健谈这次却哑口无言。

ex.s: However you start, remember there is no better time to start than right now, for you'll never be more alive than you are at this moment.

ex.s: The things we learn in maturity seldom involve information and skills． We learn to bear with the things we can't change． We learn to avoid self﹣pity． We learn that however much we try to please， some people are never going to love us﹣an idea that troubles at first but is eventually relaxing．
ex.t: 我们在成熟时学到的东西很少涉及信息和技能。我们学会忍受无法改变的事。我们学会避免自怜。我们学到，无论多么努力取悦，有些人永远不会爱我们——这个想法起初令人困扰，但最终令人释然。

ex.s: In 1928 Herbert Hoover imagined an America with “a chicken in every pot and a car in every garage.” Since then, this society has moved onward, never looking back, as the car transformed America from a farm-based society into an industrial power.zxx.k

ex.s: "That was my home． I was a teenager sitting in the hall． Before you came over， I never realized what a beautiful place I lived in． I never felt lucky before． You thought it was a museum． My feelings about my home changed after that． I've always wanted to thank you．"
ex.t: “那是我家。我当时是个坐在厅里的少年。你来之前，我从没意识到自己住的地方多美。我以前从没觉得自己幸运。你以为那是博物馆。从那以后我对家的感觉变了。我一直想谢谢你。”

ex.s: Now we live in a world surrounded by the "can't do" attitudes． We all fall down． We all have doubts and regrets． Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain． Monsters may appear or the night will fall． But never ever give up on your dream!
ex.t: 如今我们生活在一个被“做不到”态度包围的世界。我们都会跌倒。我们都有疑虑和悔恨。但我们仍须攀登，梦想山顶的风景。怪物可能出现，夜幕可能降临。但永远不要放弃你的梦想！

ex.s: Never let anyone tell you， "You can't．" Dream big and climb high！
ex.t: 永远别让任何人告诉你“你做不到”。大胆梦想，勇攀高峰！

ex.s: As the song goes, this long and winding road "will never disappear", and it will always stick in the visitor's memory.

ex.s: The most rewarding day for our group was project day，when all the efforts we put into collecting the items finally came together．When I saw the various supplies we had collected，it hit me that every kit we were to build that day would eventually be in the hands of an Iraqi child．Over the past four months，I had never imagined how I would feel once our project was completed．While making the kits，I realized that I had lost sight of the true meaning behind it．I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on．When the kits were completed，and ready to be sent overseas，the warm feeling I had was one I would never forget．
ex.t: 对我们小组来说最有收获的一天是项目日，那天我们为收集物资付出的所有努力终于汇聚在一起。当我看到我们收集到的各种物资时，我突然意识到，那天我们要制作的每一个套装最终都会送到一个伊拉克孩子手中。在过去的四个月里，我从未想象过项目完成后自己会有怎样的感受。在制作这些套装的过程中，我意识到自己已经忽略了它背后的真正意义——我只顾着把它当成又一个学校项目，而且是我想要拿高分的一个。当这些套装制作完成、准备送往海外时，那种温暖的感觉我将永远铭记。
